title: Zelensky Nominates Naftogaz Chief Koretskyi for PM; Fedorov Ousted as Defense Minister
detail: Zelensky submitted Naftogaz CEO Serhii Koretskyi's nomination for prime minister to parliament, citing winter energy preparedness as the top priority. The same reshuffle confirmed the departure of Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov — the 35-year-old digital-transformation official credited with expanding Ukraine's drone warfare program and disabling Starlink access for Russian forces — with Interior Minister Ihor Klymenko expected to take the defense portfolio. Fedorov's removal, after barely six months in the post, drew immediate criticism from soldiers and lawmakers.

media.caption: Sergii Koretskyi, CEO of Naftogaz, nominated as Ukraine's next PM
